title: Bijections on the set of extreme points in a compact convex set
summary: In a recent work, Roelands and Tiersma proved that, for a compact convex set $K$, the space $A(K)$ of all real-valued continuous affine functions on $K$, is a JB-algebra if and only if there is a gauge-reversing bijection on $A_c(K)$, the set of positive real-valued continuous affine functions on $K$. In this paper, we show that every such gauge-reversing bijection on $A_c(K)$ is completely determined by the induced bijection on the set of extreme points of $K$.
